# Chapman Cycles (concept site by Kerblabs)

> Custom bicycles hand built in Pawtuxet Village, Rhode Island, USA. Tagline: "Modern frames for vintage souls."

This is a free concept page, not the official site. Official site: https://www.chapmancycles.com

## Facts (from chapmancycles.com)
- Location: Pawtuxet Village, Rhode Island, USA. No street address or phone is published.
- Builds: 650b city and touring bikes, 700c randonneur, 650b allroad frameset, single speed, fixed gear, basket city bike, porteur, big tire road bike.
- Methods shown: silver brazing, lugged frames, modified and hand carved fork crowns.
- Prices: not stated on the pages reviewed.

## How to get on the list
- Email brian@chapmancycles.com or use https://www.chapmancycles.com/contact/
